## North stars

| ID | Outcome | Target |
|---|---|---|
| NS-CUD | Capital Under Discipline | Increase governed coverage without weakening evidence, freshness, policy, accounting, Model A isolation, or manual-execution gates. |
| NS-ALERT | Material-event-to-alert latency | P95 below one complete XASX trading session with a non-empty honest denominator. |
| NS-EDGE | Prospective after-tax-estimate, after-cost active return | No edge claim before 252 clean prospective paired sessions, 20 matured pre-registered 63-session origins, every strategy predicate, and James promotion. |

## Release gates

| Gate | Allows | Failure state |
|---|---|---|
| `operational_gate` | UNCALIBRATED | PAPER_ONLY |
| `strategy_gate` | EVIDENCE_BACKED | UNCALIBRATED |
| `promotion_gate` | EVIDENCE_BACKED | UNCALIBRATED |

The operational gate requires a frozen evaluator and thirty consecutive complete
sessions. An evidence-backed claim remains prohibited until the prospective
strategy gate and James-controlled promotion gate both pass. No gate adds broker
execution authority.

## Delivery envelope

- Surfaces: cli; daily_brief.
- Excluded surfaces: web; mobile; multi_user; public_advice; broker_connection; order_execution.
- Execution boundary: ['ASXOS may persist an exact expiring ORDER_STAGED package and a separate James disposition.', 'ASXOS cannot place, route, submit, modify, cancel, infer, or observe an external broker order or fill.']
- Model routing: {'fable_low': 'Frozen schemas, fixtures, pure implementations, adapters, rendering and bounded repairs only.', 'opus_ultra': ['Architecture and cross-context dependency decisions.', 'Finance, risk, tax, accounting, fill, benchmark and statistical semantics.', 'Migrations, capital boundaries, authority boundaries, and root-cause escalation.', 'Fresh-context independent red-team before sprint close.'], 'repair_escalation_after_failed_cycles': 2}
- Pull-request budget: {'eight_hour': {'normal_total': 1, 'absolute_max_total': 2}, 'twelve_hour': {'max_product': 2, 'max_evidence_ops': 1, 'absolute_max_total': 3}}
- James is the sole user, policy governor, approver, and external order placer.
